items.title: Does Trimble (TRMB) Arc Agent Change Its AI Push In Logistics?
items.summary: Trimble (NasdaqGS:TRMB) introduced Trimble Arc Agent, an AI-powered automation solution for transportation and logistics organizations. The new platform is designed to automate a wide range of back-office workflows and tasks for carriers, brokers and shippers. Arc Agent integrates with major transportation management systems and supports customizable skills that users can configure without engineering support.
